responsibilities: You’ll collaborate across departments to shape purposeful data products and ensure insights are accessible and actionable.
In this role, you will design and develop new reports and dashboards while advising on data model design and architecture.
You will collaborate with business stakeholders to deliver and own, together with the product team, end-to-end data products supporting our Operations and Technical Support department.

This includes defining the purpose, roadmap, and delivery of data products, from data pipelines through to the final dashboard, ensuring that business needs are translated into impactful and user-friendly data solutions.
